description: Simulate agent payment policies for tokenized A2A corridors: set spend caps, MCC allowlists, velocity throttles, and approval thresholds; run synthetic transactions against the policy and export the result as a Policy Mandate. Browser-based, client-side only, zero PII. Renders the interactive AINumbers tool as a widget; inputs are applied via the AIN Bridge and the tool runs client-side (zero PII, zero network). Output schema: call describe_tool("agentic_mandate_sandbox").

inputs.description: Map of tool input element IDs to values (see manifest input_schema). Applied via AIN Bridge prefill.
